query: Why are CPF transfers not eligible for the matching grant under Matched Retirement Savings Scheme?
reference_answer: The Matched Retirement Savings Scheme is designed to encourage cash top-ups to senior Singapore Citizens with lower retirement savings to help them save more. Thus, only cash top-ups to eligible members will be matched.Members making CPF transfers can still benefit from the higher interest rate in the Retirement Account.
answer: CPF transfers are not eligible for the matching grant under the Matched Retirement Savings Scheme because the scheme only covers contributions made directly into a retirement account. CPF transfers are considered withdrawals, thus not qualifying for the matching grant. [Document 1]
